title: Cyclone Murasu: Cuddalore announces school holiday, IMD warns of heavy rainfall in Tamil Nadu - Mid-Day

Cyclone Murasu: Cuddalore announces school holiday, amid heavy rainfall warning 
 Home / News / India News / Article / Cyclone Murasu: Cuddalore announces school holiday, IMD warns of heavy rainfall in Tamil Nadu 
 Cyclone Murasu: Cuddalore announces school holiday, IMD warns of heavy rainfall in Tamil Nadu
 Updated On: 03 November, 2026 11:35 AM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 Schools in parts of Tamil Nadu’s Cuddalore district have been closed on Tuesday due to heavy rainfall and thunderstorms triggered by Cyclone Murasu. The IMD has forecast further showers across Tamil Nadu, including Chennai, the Nilgiris, Theni and Dindigul
 Listen to this article : Trees bend amid strong winds and heavy rain as Cyclone Murasu hits the coastal town, in Bapatla district, Andhra Pradesh on Tuesday. PIC/AFP
 Schools across Cuddalore in Tamil Nadu have been given a holiday on Tuesday in wake of the heavy rainfall triggered by Cyclone Murasu, which has impacted the coast of Andhra Pradesh.
 The Cuddalore District Collector declared the holiday as thunderstorms, lightning and continuous rainfall disrupted normal life in numerous parts of the district. The holiday applies to schools in Cuddalore taluk, as well as areas affected by intense rainfall around Cuddalore town, Reddichavadi and Nellikuppam.
